text: Shadow work to me is neither BDSM nor "feeding your demons." It means bringing loving awareness to the parts of the mind built in fear, pain, humiliation, rejection, and survival. Inner-child reparenting is central. Most negative mind-states aren't some error in your philosophy, they're just young parts of you that are still waiting for love and protection and permission, and for the explanation nobody ever gave them.
section: The Other Bypass: Feeling Good Forever, after his first two marriages
reader: someone who meditates or uses psychedelics to feel good, wondering whether shadow work matters
